children: Amazon.com Inc. (AMZN, Financials), the e-commerce and cloud computing corporation, is expanding its food business and same-day delivery network and offered a $25 Thanksgiving dinner package.
The package contains an 8-pound turkey, plus fixings for standard sides and dessert.
Amazon said consumers in more than 2,300 U.S. cities and towns may purchase the meal through its same-day shopping service, with free delivery on orders of $25 or more that meet the conditions.
The bundle is good through Nov. 26 or while supplies last.
The offer also spotlights a bigger effort by Amazon into food prices. It claimed its Amazon Grocery and Amazon Saver private label brands now include over 1,200 goods, most priced around $5.
For an investor, a single holiday promotion has a limited direct financial impact.
The bigger question is whether aggressive price and convenience will help Amazon win grocery market, boost order frequency and make its delivery network more productive.
The next catalyst will be whether holiday promotions at grocery stores translate into higher same-day delivery use and consumer engagement through the fourth quarter.

title: Amazon Launches $25 Thanksgiving Meal With Same-Day Delivery
